pages.text: Altered from $(5)Sharpness$(), $(4)Xenophobia$() greatly increases damage against enemies that aren't undead, arthropods or aquatic. Maximum level is $(4)V$() and it conflicts with $(5)Sharpness$(), $(5)Smite$(), $(5)Bane of Arthropods$(), $(5)Impaling$() and $(4)Hunter's Exultation$(). While Sharpness is better for general use, Xenophobia still has its use cases, just like any other specialized damage enchantment.
